column1: The waiter was incredibly rude and ignored our table for twenty minutes while serving everyone else. The pasta was lukewarm and the olive oil tasted rancid.
I found a stray hair in my steak and the server dismissed it when I pointed it out. The place was also quite dirty with crumbs on the high tables.
Staff ignored our reservation and made us wait an hour before seating us. The wine pairing was expensive but the food wasn't worth the price tag.
Cleanliness was non-existent; the bathroom hadn't been mopped in days and the counter was sticky. I will definitely not be returning to this establishment.

Service was adequate and the staff were polite enough, though a bit slow. The pasta was standard Italian fare, nothing special but not bad. Prices were slightly higher than average for the portion sizes.

The haircut was exactly what I asked for, though the stylist was a bit chatty. The waiting area was clean and comfortable enough for the appointment. Overall, it was a typical mid-tier experience with no major ups or downs.

I ordered the special of the day which was okay but overpriced at $25. The salad dressing was too strong and ruined the flavor of the greens. The ambience was pleasant but the music was a bit too loud to converse easily.

Staff greeted us promptly but seemed a bit distracted by their phones. The coffee was decent quality, though the pastries were stale. The location is convenient for a quick stop, but not worth the premium pricing.

The server was incredibly friendly and even recommended a dish that turned out perfect. The filet mignon was cooked exactly to order and the side vegetables were fresh. I'm definitely coming back here for special occasions.

Best customer service I've experienced in years; they remembered my name from my last visit. The interior was spotless and the seating was very comfortable for a long lunch. Prices are reasonable for the high quality of the ingredients used.

My stylist really listened to my concerns and delivered a fantastic cut. The entire salon was immaculate and the products used were top-tier brands. It was worth every penny for the attention to detail and the relaxing atmosphere.

The team fixed my car issue in half the time they estimated and the final bill was exactly what they quoted. The waiting room was clean and they provided free Wi-Fi and coffee. I trust them completely now and will recommend them to friends.
